HF18.4:
- process-scoped policy-independent UNCANNY.exe bootstrap so Restricted/AllSigned cannot silently kill startup
- persistent machine/user PowerShell execution policy is not changed
- Defender and SmartScreen are not disabled
- updater hotfix serial ordering fixed (HF18.3=1830, HF18.4=1840)
- StrictMode-safe launcher discovery/cache/installed-game path handling
- official cropped silver UNCANNY U PNG launcher emblem
- stale/unmarked Lucid preferences migrate to Automatic/ELYSIUM
- only explicit current UserSelected=1 choices may preserve Lucid
- HF18 rendering and Universal API Bridge behavior preserved

Exact package gates: build PASS; Windows startup PASS; AllSigned startup PASS; WARP PASS; ZIP/hash PASS; Defender PASS / 0 detections.

Signing status: unsigned. Windows SmartScreen/Unknown Publisher warnings may remain until trusted Authenticode signing is configured.
